title: Light Japanese Oats Mochi
description: A refreshing and unique dessert featuring oats in a glassy-jelly texture, perfect for a date night. This pescatarian-friendly dish is easy to make and requires minimal ingredients.

ingredients.name: koji powder
ingredients.notes: Available at Asian grocery stores or online.

ingredients.name: agar agar powder
ingredients.notes: Available at Asian grocery stores or online.

instructions: Combine the oats, water, and salt in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the rice flour, koji powder, sugar, matcha powder, vanilla extract, and agar agar powder to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Add the water chestnut and sesame seeds to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Knead the mixture until it forms a dough.
Divide the dough into small balls and flatten them slightly.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and add a small amount of coconut oil.
Cook the mochi balls for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are lightly browned.
Serve the light Japanese oats mochi warm, garnished with sesame seeds if desired.
If desired, add a spoonful of miso paste to the mochi balls for extra flavor.
